nativeBeforeConsoleClassification.methodology: Actual native Electron dev renderer, production UI and stores, packed default adapters and source browser. Synthetic metadata; editor/console/environment panes closed, normal AI/context UI rendered. Timings include synchronous React search handlers; cold time includes Playwright and UI mount. Resident memory measured with Electron process metrics after forced GC; transient pre-GC peaks and whole-app pane rendering are not certified. Loopback mock model, no real inference or R source reads.
